$schema: See scripts/audit-check.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date.
$policy: Exceptions are deferrals, not pardons. An entry is only justified when the advisory cannot be fixed without a breaking upgrade AND the exposure does not reach a shipped build or a user's device. Anything reachable from the app bundle gets fixed, not listed.

allow.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating an oversized array against a schema with no length limit. The repo's own zod, which eslint-plugin-react-hooks uses, is on 4.6.7 and patched. What remains is the zod 3.25.76 nested under @expo/cli, which validates the CLI's own config and API responses on a developer's machine or in CI; the app does not import zod and it is not in the bundle. The fix is 4.6.6, a major version away from the 3.x API @expo/cli is written against, and 3.25.76 is the last 3.x release, so this waits for Expo to move to zod 4.
